notes:
High-level summary:
- Buyer: VP of Support (Clara Reynolds). Quote from call: "We need summaries our agents can trust — no invented ticket particulars."
- Primary ops: multi-brand Zendesk deployment (two instances), several thousand tickets/day across spikes (holiday/launch windows).
- Key asks: reliable ticket/email summarization (concise, source-linked), automated tag extraction for routing/prioritization, macros/tool-calls to set fields/create follow-ups, and graceful behavior during 3x-5x traffic spikes.
- Latency/throughput targets: median single-ticket summary <400ms, 95th <800ms; burst target ~60 QPS sustained for 10m windows; cold-start handling + cache reuse for repeat prefixes.
- Quality requirements: conservative summaries (no hallucination), extractive + abstractive hybrid acceptable, confidence score and provenance links required for audit.
- Model preferences: open-models preferred but must pass hallucination/regression evals; interested in quantized variants for cost. For mission-critical escalations allow routing to larger QA-verified model.
- Routing/fallback requirements: prefer policy-driven routing (by priority, customer tier, region) with automatic fallback to smaller model or queued processing when capacity constrained.
- Integrations: Zendesk triggers/macros, Freshdesk fallback for smaller brands, Slack agent overlay, internal ticketing webhook to ticketmesh backend.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS for key management, audit logs for every generated edit, and EU data residency for EMEA customers.
- Commercial: mid-market ARR target with potential expansion to enterprise Dedicated if POC shows predictable peak handling. Estimated initial ARR $120k-$300k with possibility to scale.
- Risk notes: legal needs clear data residency routing map; performance under real-world spikes still unknown — SE requested traces to simulate.
- Proxy/POC plan: run 2-week sandbox on Redwood Hosted API for rapid iteration, then stress test on Dedicated pool if latency and determinism meet SLAs.
- Action items: AE to send Zendesk integration checklist; SE to upload POC configuration and evaluation prompts; legal to circulate residency matrix.
- Short-form next-step: "POC kickoff w/ SE (Maya) w/in 1 week; engineering to replay peak traces."
